title: MyClaw 3.0
lede: MyClaw 3.0 runs a team of agents on always-on cloud machines, each with its own role, tools and model, all drawing on one memory the whole team shares.

points: Teammates can be built on OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, Pi and other agents, each picking from more than 50 models.
Each agent gets a role, tools and skills; the launch comment suggests starting from presets such as Researcher or Content Creator.
Agents keep working on cloud computers while you are offline, using your apps and data for recurring jobs.
Work is assigned from the web, Slack, Telegram or WhatsApp, with no servers to manage and no tie to one model provider.
Several commenters asked how conflicting writes to the shared memory are resolved; the launch material does not say.

sections.text: People who want to brief an agent the way they would brief a colleague, step away, and come back to finished work to review, without running their own servers.
